landing.lead: Most rejections are for things you could have seen first: a name that differs from Aadhaar, an exit date your employer never marked, a bank account that is not verified. PF Nikaalo runs those checks before you file, picks the right form for you, shows the money and the tax, and then tells you who is doing what, and when.

UAN_ACTIVE.label: UAN is active
UAN_ACTIVE.fail: Your UAN is not active. EPFO has to activate it before any claim.

AADHAAR_SEEDED.label: Aadhaar linked
AADHAAR_SEEDED.fail: Aadhaar is not linked to this UAN. Link it on the portal first.

NAME_MATCH.label: Name matches Aadhaar
NAME_MATCH.pass: The name on your EPFO record matches Aadhaar.
NAME_MATCH.fail: The name on your EPFO record does not match Aadhaar. EPFO rejects for this even when only a middle name is missing.

DOB_MATCH.label: Date of birth matches
DOB_MATCH.fail: Date of birth on your record does not match Aadhaar.

DOE_PRESENT.label: Date of exit marked
DOE_PRESENT.pass: Your date of exit is on record.
DOE_PRESENT.fail: Your employer has not marked your date of exit. The portal will not let you file a final settlement without it.

TWO_MONTH_WAIT.label: Waiting period over
TWO_MONTH_WAIT.pass: The waiting period after exit is over.
TWO_MONTH_WAIT.fail: Final settlement needs two months after your date of exit. You can take an advance now and settle later.

BANK_KYC.label: Bank account verified
BANK_KYC.fail: Your bank account is not verified. Money cannot be sent to an unverified account, so EPFO rejects.

BANK_NAME_MATCH.label: Bank account name
BANK_NAME_MATCH.pass: The name on the bank account matches.
BANK_NAME_MATCH.fail: The name on the bank account does not match your Aadhaar name.
BANK_NAME_MATCH.warn: The bank account name is a short form of your name. It usually passes, but a re-seed removes the doubt.

PAN_SEEDED.label: PAN linked
PAN_SEEDED.warn: PAN is not linked. If tax applies, it is deducted at 20% instead of 10%. Link it in a minute.

NO_DUPLICATE_CLAIM.label: No duplicate claim
NO_DUPLICATE_CLAIM.fail: A claim is already pending or settled for this. EPFO will reject a second one.

SERVICE_OVERLAP.label: Service dates consistent
SERVICE_OVERLAP.pass: Your employment dates do not overlap.
SERVICE_OVERLAP.fail: Two employers report overlapping dates. EPFO holds claims until an employer corrects it.

EPS_ELIGIBLE.label: Pension part
EPS_ELIGIBLE.pass: You can withdraw your pension (EPS) benefit.
EPS_ELIGIBLE.fail: Pension benefit is not payable for this service length.
EPS_ELIGIBLE.warn: With 10 or more years of service, the pension part becomes a scheme certificate instead of a withdrawal. You keep the pension.

E_NOMINATION.label: e-Nomination
E_NOMINATION.warn: e-Nomination is not filed. Not needed for this claim, but it protects your family. Two minutes.

UPDATE_PROFILE.label: Update my profile to match Aadhaar
UPDATE_PROFILE.steps: On the member portal: Manage → Modify Basic Details → tick the fields that differ → verify with Aadhaar OTP. Because your UAN was issued after October 2017, no employer or document is needed.

MARK_EXIT.label: Mark my own date of exit
MARK_EXIT.steps: On the member portal: Manage → Mark Exit → choose the employer → enter the last working day → verify with Aadhaar OTP. Allowed two months after your last contribution.

RESEED_BANK.label: Re-seed my bank account
RESEED_BANK.steps: On the member portal: Manage → KYC → Bank → enter the account number and IFSC exactly as on your cheque or passbook, in your Aadhaar name → save. Your employer approves; NPCI validates the name.

SEED_PAN.label: Link my PAN
SEED_PAN.steps: On the member portal: Manage → KYC → PAN → enter PAN → it verifies against the income-tax database instantly.

NAME_MISMATCH.steps: Ask your employer for a joint declaration (Annexure) with your Aadhaar copy, or use the portal's Modify Basic Details if your UAN was issued after October 2017.

DOB_MISMATCH.steps: Modify Basic Details with Aadhaar OTP, or a joint declaration through your employer for older UANs.

DOE_NOT_AVAILABLE.steps: Mark Exit yourself after two months, or ask your employer to file it in their monthly ECR.

BANK_KYC_NOT_VERIFIED.steps: Re-seed the bank account in your Aadhaar name and ask your employer to approve the KYC.

BANK_NAME_DIFFERS.steps: Get the bank to correct the account name to your Aadhaar name, or seed a different account that already matches.

PAN_NOT_VERIFIED.steps: Link PAN under KYC. If your PAN name differs from Aadhaar, correct it with the income-tax department first.

SERVICE_OVERLAP.steps: Ask the employer with the wrong dates to correct your date of joining or exit in their ECR.

CLAIM_ALREADY_SETTLED.steps: Nothing to re-file. Check your passbook for the credit; if the money never arrived, raise a grievance on EPFiGMS.

WRONG_FORM.steps: Come back and let us pick the form again; the waiting period or your service length changed what you can claim.

UNCLEAR_CHEQUE.steps: Upload a clear photo of a cheque leaf or the passbook page with your name, account number and IFSC printed.

PAYMENT_RETURNED.steps: The bank bounced the credit. Confirm the account is active and in your name, re-seed it, and request re-authorisation.

PENDING_WITH_EMPLOYER.steps: Your employer has to approve. Send them a reminder; if they do not act, EPFO's grievance portal can escalate.

EPS_NOT_ELIGIBLE.steps: Pension withdrawal needs at least six months of service. Below that, only the PF part is payable.

SIGNATURE_DIFFERS.steps: For offline claims only. File online with Aadhaar OTP instead; no signature needed.

rationale.FORM_19: You have left your job and two months have passed, so the whole PF balance can be settled with Form 19.
rationale.FORM_10C: Fewer than ten years of pension service, so the pension (EPS) part is paid out as a withdrawal benefit with Form 10C.
rationale.FORM_31: Final settlement is not open yet, so Form 31 gives you an advance of up to 75% now; the rest settles after the waiting period.
rationale.SCHEME_CERTIFICATE: Ten or more years of pension service cannot be withdrawn; a scheme certificate keeps your pension rights for age 58.

notAllowed.tenYears: Form 10C is not allowed after ten years of service; you get a scheme certificate instead.
notAllowed.wait: Final settlement opens two months after your date of exit. Until then only an advance is possible.

exempt.fiveYears: No TDS: five or more years of continuous service.
exempt.threshold: No TDS: the claim is ₹50,000 or less.
exempt.reason: No TDS: your exit was for a reason beyond your control (ill health or employer closure).
exempt.form121: No TDS: you declared Form 121 (income below the taxable limit).

under5yrs.pan: TDS at 10% under section 192A: fewer than five years of service and the claim is above ₹50,000. PAN is linked.
under5yrs.noPan: TDS at 20% under section 192A because PAN is not linked. Link PAN to bring it to 10%.

rejection.canRefile: You can file again once this is fixed.
rejection.cannotRefile: This claim cannot be filed again.

NAME_MISMATCH.epfo: Name mismatch with Aadhaar / Member details mismatch
NAME_MISMATCH.plain: The name EPFO holds for you is not the same as the one on your Aadhaar. Even a missing middle name counts.

DOB_MISMATCH.plain: The date of birth on your EPFO record differs from Aadhaar.

DOE_NOT_AVAILABLE.plain: Your employer never told EPFO that you left. Without an exit date, a final settlement cannot be processed.

BANK_KYC_NOT_VERIFIED.epfo: KYC incomplete / Bank details not verified
BANK_KYC_NOT_VERIFIED.plain: The bank account on your record was never verified, so EPFO has nowhere safe to send the money.

BANK_NAME_DIFFERS.plain: The name on your bank account is not the same as your Aadhaar name, so the payment cannot be released.

PAN_NOT_VERIFIED.plain: Your PAN is missing or could not be verified. Tax has to be worked out before payment.

SERVICE_OVERLAP.plain: Two employers report you working for them at the same time. EPFO waits until one of them corrects the dates.

CLAIM_ALREADY_SETTLED.plain: EPFO has already paid this claim. A second one for the same thing is rejected.

WRONG_FORM.plain: The form filed does not match what you are eligible for right now.

UNCLEAR_CHEQUE.plain: The photo of your cheque or passbook could not be read.

PAYMENT_RETURNED.plain: EPFO sent the money, but your bank returned it. Usually the account is closed, inactive, or in another name.

PENDING_WITH_EMPLOYER.epfo: Pending with employer / Rejected by employer
PENDING_WITH_EMPLOYER.plain: Your employer has to approve something (KYC, exit date or the claim itself) and has not.

EPS_NOT_ELIGIBLE.plain: Your pension service is too short for a withdrawal benefit.

SIGNATURE_DIFFERS.plain: On a paper claim, the signature did not match the one on file.

how.title: How it works, honestly
how.sub: What is real code, what is simulated, and how it would run at scale.
real: The rules engine: eligibility, form choice, amounts, TDS, status and rejection meanings are pure, tested TypeScript (94 unit tests). Every check on the pre-flight screen comes from it.
The complete journey: login, triage, checks, fixes, claim, review, filing, tracking and the rejection explainer all work end to end in your browser.
The language layer: English and Hindi from one dictionary, checked for parity at build time.
The assistant: answers come from the rules engine and your own record, not from a chatbot guessing.
how.mockTitle: What is simulated, and what the real thing is

mock.name: EPFO member record
mock.real: EPFO member database (UAN, KYC, service history) via an approved API.

mock.name: UIDAI e-KYC
mock.sim: Returns the seeded Aadhaar record after a delay.
mock.real: Aadhaar e-KYC through an AUA/KUA with consent capture and the member's OTP.

mock.name: NPCI bank validation
mock.sim: Compares the account name in code.
mock.real: NPCI account-name verification (penny-drop or name-match API).

mock.name: Employer filings
mock.real: Employer ECR workflow with reminders and escalation through EPFiGMS.

mock.name: Claim status
mock.sim: A schedule computed from the filing date; the demo clock moves time.
mock.real: EPFO claim event stream (received, processed, approved, NEFT) pushed as notifications.

mock.name: OTP and signing
mock.real: Aadhaar OTP through UIDAI; consent and audit logged.

how.scaleTitle: What it would take to run this for real
scale: Consent and privacy: DPDP-compliant consent for Aadhaar and bank checks; nothing stored beyond the session without purpose.
Reliability: every external call idempotent, queued and retried; a check that cannot run says so instead of guessing.
Audit: every check, fix and filing written to an append-only log the member can see.
Rules as code: the eligibility and TDS rules versioned with effective dates, so a rule change never silently rewrites old claims.
Accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA, Hindi and more languages, works on 2G with the JavaScript off for the read-only parts.
how.codexBody: Codex (OpenAI) was a build tool on this project, driven non-interactively from scripts. Each session is a separate commit with a Codex co-author line and an entry in CODEX_LOG.md in the repository, so the contribution is verifiable in git history.

sources.text: Self-service date of exit and profile corrections (UANs after Oct 2017)
TDS under section 192A: 10% with PAN below five years, 20% without
Auto-settlement within 72 hours up to ₹5 lakh; 20-day outer limit
Rejection rates: about 26% of claims, one in three final settlements
Rejection reasons as EPFO phrases them

how.limits: EPS Table D factors and the no-PAN rate are indicative. The fixes shown are the portal's own steps as of August 2026; EPFO changes them. No government logo, data or system is used.

assistant.fallback: I can answer about your checks, forms, the amount, tax, timelines and rejection reasons. Try one of the suggestions.

answers.rejectRisk_clear: Right now nothing on your record would get the claim rejected. File it.
answers.rejectRisk_blocked: As it stands, EPFO would reject for: {items}. Fix those on the checks screen and I will re-run.
answers.tds_none: No tax is deducted on this claim: {reason}
answers.tds_some: ₹{amount} would be deducted ({rate}) because {reason} You would receive ₹{net}.
answers.timeline_fast: All checks passed, so this qualifies for auto-settlement: money usually lands in three to four working days.
answers.timeline_standard: The standard process takes up to 20 days; most claims settle in 12 to 18.
answers.form121: Form 121 is the declaration that your total income for the year is below the taxable limit. From 1 April 2026 it replaces Forms 15G and 15H. If it is true for you, declare it on the claim screen and no TDS is deducted.
answers.doe: If two months have passed since your last contribution, you can mark your own exit date on the portal (Manage → Mark Exit) with Aadhaar OTP. Before that, only your employer can. I can send them the request.
answers.forms: You do not need to know form numbers. Based on what you told me, we file: {forms}.
answers.amount: Your PF balance is ₹{pfGross}. After tax you would receive ₹{net}.
answers.greeting: Namaste. Ask me about your checks, the form, the money, the tax or the timeline.
